hero.subtitle: A cooperative in the heart of Morocco — honey, fresh produce, camping under the stars, and a warm welcome since 2022.

about.title: A Living Cooperative
about.body: Mouzoun was born from a shared dream — to cultivate the land, preserve ancestral know-how, and open our doors to curious travellers. Rooted in the Moroccan countryside at the foot of the Anti-Atlas mountains, our cooperative brings together farmers, beekeepers, herders and hosts who care deeply about their territory.

values.title: Authentic
values.desc: Real products, real people, real land

values.title: Welcoming
values.desc: Every visitor is a guest of the family

offerings.title: What We Offer
offerings.subtitle: From our hives to your table, from our fields to your camping pitch — Mouzoun is an experience.

items.title: Artisan Honey
items.desc: Pure, raw honey harvested from our apiaries nestled in wild thyme and sidr blossom. Every jar tells a story of the flowers and the bees.

items.title: Farm Produce
items.desc: Seasonal vegetables, argan products, and traditional cereals grown with care and without shortcuts.

items.title: Camping
items.desc: Pitch your tent under a sky full of stars. Wake up to birdsong, birdsong, and fresh mountain air. Our site has everything you need and nothing you don't.

items.title: Cattle & Livestock
items.desc: Our herd graze the open hills. Visit, learn, and taste farm-fresh dairy products made from our own animals.

items.title: Experiences
items.desc: Guided hikes, cultural tours, traditional cooking classes and more — curated to help you connect with this place and its people.

location.title: Find Us
location.subtitle: We are located in the south of Morocco, in the foothills of the Anti-Atlas range — a landscape of wild beauty and silence.
location.directions: From Agadir, take the N1 south to Tiznit, then follow the P1702 toward Tata. We are signposted from the main road.

contact.title: Get In Touch
contact.subtitle: Planning a visit? Have a question about our products? We would love to hear from you.

footer.tagline: A cooperative rooted in the land of Morocco.
